headline: Appointments of a principal for Greene-Hills School, an assistant principal for Chippens Hill Middle School, and a dean of pupil personnel services.
summary: The meeting will discuss and possibly act on three school staff appointments. The positions are principal, assistant principal, and dean of pupil personnel services.
items: Appointment of the Principal of Greene-Hills School
Appointment of the Assistant Principal of Chippens Hill Middle School
Appointment of the Dean of Pupil Personnel Services
location: BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 06010
plain_text:
Special Board of Education Meeting
Wednesday, August 12, 2026 5:00 PM
BOE Auditorium and via Zoom Meeting Platform, 129 Church Street, Bristol, CT 
06010
